nights.title: CKay - Rotterdam
nights.name: CKay
nights.extract: Chukwuka Chukwuma Ekweani, better known by his stage name Ckay, is a Nigerian singer, songwriter and record producer, who is the co-founder and CEO of Boyfriend Music. He was formerly signed to Chocolate City, a member of Warner Music Group independent label services ADA before joining Warner Music Africa and Atlantic Records. His international hit single "Love Nwantiti", also known as "Love Nwantiti ", was released in 2019 by Chocolate City.

en.who: Chukwuka Chukwuma Ekweani, better known by his stage name Ckay, is a Nigerian singer, songwriter and record producer. He was formerly signed to Chocolate City before joining Warner Music Africa and Atlantic Records.
facts: He is the co-founder and CEO of Boyfriend Music.
His international hit single "Love Nwantiti" was released in 2019 by Chocolate City.

de.who: Chukwuka Chukwuma Ekweani, bekannt unter dem Künstlernamen Ckay, ist ein nigerianischer Sänger, Songwriter und Musikproduzent. Er war zuvor bei Chocolate City unter Vertrag, bevor er zu Warner Music Africa und Atlantic Records wechselte.
facts: Er ist Mitbegründer und CEO von Boyfriend Music.
Sein internationaler Hit „Love Nwantiti“ erschien 2019 bei Chocolate City.

tr.who: Chukwuka Chukwuma Ekweani, sahne adı Ckay olan Nijeryalı bir şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve müzik yapımcısıdır. Önce Chocolate City ile sözleşmeliydi, sonra Warner Music Africa ve Atlantic Records'a geçti.
facts: Boyfriend Music'in kurucu ortağı ve CEO'sudur.
Uluslararası hit single'ı "Love Nwantiti" 2019'da Chocolate City tarafından yayımlandı.

nights.title: Papa Roach – Rise Of The Roach
nights.name: Papa Roach
nights.extract: Papa Roach is an American rock band from Vacaville, California, formed in 1993. After a few early shifts, the band initially stabilized in 1996 with the lineup of lead vocalist Jacoby Shaddix, drummer Dave Buckner, guitarist Jerry Horton, and bassist Tobin Esperance. This lineup remained consistent for slightly over a decade.

en.who: Papa Roach is an American rock band from Vacaville, California, formed in 1993. Its lineup settled in 1996 and remained consistent for slightly over a decade.
facts: The band initially stabilized in 1996 with the lineup of lead vocalist Jacoby Shaddix, drummer Dave Buckner, guitarist Jerry Horton, and bassist Tobin Esperance.
This lineup remained consistent for slightly over a decade.

de.who: Papa Roach ist eine amerikanische Rockband aus Vacaville, Kalifornien, die 1993 gegründet wurde. Die Besetzung blieb über etwas mehr als ein Jahrzehnt weitgehend beständig.
facts: Die Band stabilisierte sich 1996 erstmals mit der Besetzung um Leadsänger Jacoby Shaddix, Schlagzeuger Dave Buckner, Gitarrist Jerry Horton und Bassist Tobin Esperance.
Diese Besetzung blieb über etwas mehr als ein Jahrzehnt beständig.

tr.who: Papa Roach, 1993 yılında kurulmuş, Kaliforniya'nın Vacaville kentinden bir Amerikan rock grubudur. Kadro 1996'da yerleşti ve on yıldan biraz fazla bir süre değişmeden kaldı.
facts: Grup 1996'da, baş vokal Jacoby Shaddix, davulcu Dave Buckner, gitarist Jerry Horton ve basçı Tobin Esperance'ın yer aldığı kadro ile ilk kez istikrara kavuştu.
Bu kadro on yıldan biraz fazla bir süre boyunca değişmeden kaldı.

nights.title: Salvador Sobral
nights.name: Salvador Sobral
nights.extract: Salvador Vilar Braamcamp Sobral is a Portuguese singer, who won the Eurovision Song Contest 2017 for Portugal with the song "Amar pelos dois", written and composed by his sister, Luísa Sobral. In doing so, he gave Portugal its first ever win in the contest since its debut in 1964, ending the longest winless run by a country in Eurovision history. Sobral and his entry hold the Eurovision record for the highest-scoring winner, having earned a total of 758 points under the current voting system, after winning both the jury vote and televote.

en.who: Salvador Vilar Braamcamp Sobral is a Portuguese singer. He won the Eurovision Song Contest 2017 for Portugal, giving the country its first ever win in the contest.
facts: He won the Eurovision Song Contest 2017 for Portugal with the song "Amar pelos dois", written and composed by his sister, Luísa Sobral.
Sobral and his entry hold the Eurovision record for the highest-scoring winner, having earned a total of 758 points under the current voting system, after winning both the jury vote and televote.

de.who: Salvador Vilar Braamcamp Sobral ist ein portugiesischer Sänger. Mit seinem Sieg beim Eurovision Song Contest 2017 holte er für Portugal den ersten Sieg des Landes im Wettbewerb.
facts: Er gewann den Eurovision Song Contest 2017 für Portugal mit dem Lied „Amar pelos dois“, das von seiner Schwester Luísa Sobral geschrieben und komponiert wurde.

Sobral und sein Beitrag halten den Eurovision-Rekord für den höchsten Punktestand eines Siegers mit insgesamt 758 Punkten nach dem aktuellen Abstimmungssystem, nachdem sie sowohl die Jury- als auch die Televoting-Wertung gewannen.

tr.who: Salvador Vilar Braamcamp Sobral Portekizli bir şarkıcıdır. 2017 Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nı Portekiz adına kazanarak ülkeye yarışmadaki ilk zaferini getirmiştir.
facts: 2017 Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nı Portekiz adına, kız kardeşi Luísa Sobral'ın yazıp bestelediği "Amar pelos dois" şarkısıyla kazandı.
Sobral ve şarkısı, hem jüri hem de televote oylamasını kazanarak, mevcut oylama sistemine göre toplam 758 puanla Eurovision'un en yüksek puanlı kazananı rekorunu elinde tutmaktadır.

nights.title: INNA - Echoes Tour 2026 - Rotterdam
nights.name: Inna
nights.extract: Elena Alexandra Apostoleanu, known professionally as Inna, is a Romanian singer and songwriter. Born in Mangalia and raised in Neptun, she studied political science at Ovidius University before meeting the Romanian trio Play & Win and pursuing a music career. She adopted the stage name "Alessandra" and a pop-rock style in 2008; later that year, she changed her stage name to "Inna" and began releasing EDM, house and popcorn music. en.who: Elena Alexandra Apostoleanu, known professionally as Inna, is a Romanian singer and songwriter. She was born in Mangalia and raised in Neptun, and she studied political science before pursuing a music career.
facts: "Hot" (2008), her debut single, was a commercial success worldwide and topped the Romanian and Billboard's Hot Dance Airplay chart, among others.
Her debut studio album of the same name followed in August 2009 and was certified Gold and Platinum.

de.who: Elena Alexandra Apostoleanu, bekannt als Inna, ist eine rumänische Sängerin und Songwriterin. Sie wurde in Mangalia geboren, wuchs in Neptun auf und studierte Politikwissenschaft, bevor sie eine Musikkarriere begann.
facts: „Hot“ (2008), ihre Debütsingle, war weltweit ein kommerzieller Erfolg und erreichte unter anderem die Spitze der rumänischen und der Billboard-Hot-Dance-Airplay-Charts.
Ihr gleichnamiges Debütalbum folgte im August 2009 und wurde mit Gold und Platin ausgezeichnet.

tr.kicker: romanyalı şarkıcı ve söz yazarı · romanya, 2008
tr.who: Elena Alexandra Apostoleanu, sahne adı Inna olan Romanyalı bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Mangalia'da doğdu, Neptun'da büyüdü ve müzik kariyerinden önce siyaset bilimi okudu.
facts: "Hot" (2008), debut single'ı olarak dünya çapında ticari bir başarı yakaladı ve diğerlerinin yanında Romanya ile Billboard'un Hot Dance Airplay listesinde zirveye yükseldi.
Aynı adı taşıyan debut albümü Ağustos 2009'da çıktı ve Gold ile Platinum sertifikası aldı.
